body.p: After . Owns src/schema_assertion.c, tests/schema_assertion_test.c. xs:assert on complex types and xs:assertion facets on simple types (Part 1, 3.13; Part 2, 4.3.13: $value), and conditional type assignment (xs:alternative, Part 1, 3.12): XPath compiled with xpath.h in the schema document's static context (namespaces, xpathDefaultNamespace, the base URI, the F&O function library), so the XPath 2.0 of XSD 1.1 is read by the XPath 4.0 front end (a superset; XSD 1.1 allows it as an extension); evaluated on the recorded subtree (assertions: the element with its validated descendants, comments and processing instructions excluded; alternatives: the element with its attributes and inherited attributes, no children). Simple type assertions are checked by validation; casting to a type with assertions in a schema-aware expression evaluates them as a second step of the cast (5.11), never from inside src/cast.c. Done when Saxon Assert and CTA, IBM assert, assertion, CTA, typeAlternatives, typeAlternativesMixed ≥ 80%. Done 2026-10-18 (): tests compiled with xpath.h in XPath Valid's static context; assertions on an assertion copy of the recorded subtree, assertion facets with $value (list items, union members), simpleContent assertion facets on the simple content type, type alternatives with inherited attributes, type table equivalence. The six test sets 448 of 448 (100 %); XSD in scope 41,037 of 41,518.
